title: RRB ALP CBT-II Answer Key 2026

selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:

2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download RRB Assistant Loco Pilot ALP CEN 01/2025 CBT II Answer Key 2026

shortDescription: RRB ALP CEN 01/2025 CBT II Answer Key 2026 out. Check response sheet on RRB portals.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards have released the ALP CBT-II Answer Key / Response Sheet 2026 for CEN 01/2025.

Candidates should login on their regional RRB website, download keys, and raise objections within the stipulated time if allowed.
